shared_elements: figures with headdress or tall cap
repeated small motifs in a row
justification: Both are grey stone surfaces worked in low relief with standing human figures, circular disc-like motifs and horizontal dividing bands, which is about as far as the correspondence goes. A is a single massive frontal figure whose motifs are stacked on a body-shaped monolith in a coarse, heavily eroded shallow carving, whereas B is a flat wall of crisply cut, evenly spaced profile figures marching in repeated registers separated by rosette borders — a completely different compositional logic and level of technical finish.
